nodes.title: Theorem 1.1 · ω = 9/4
nodes.summary: Over every field F, the exponent of square matrix multiplication is exactly 9/4.
nodes.tex:
Over every field \(F\), the exponent of square matrix multiplication is
\(\omega_F=9/4\).

nodes.title: Corollary 1.2 · Finite-size rank wall
nodes.summary: At every n ≥ 2: geometric border rank ≥ n^(9/4), asymptotic rank = n^(9/4), circuits need ≥ ⌈n^(9/4)/2⌉ nonlinear gates. Refutes Strassen's 1994 tight-tensor conjecture and Sun's 2^17 bound at n = 256.
nodes.tex:
For every \(n\ge2\) and every field \(F\), the geometric border rank of
\(T_n\) is at least \(n^{9/4}\), and the asymptotic rank of \(T_n\) over
\(F\) equals \(n^{9/4}\). Every formal arithmetic circuit over \(F\)
for this product has at least \(\lceil n^{9/4}/2\rceil\) nonscalar
multiplication or division gates.

nodes.title: Corollary 1.3 · Rectangular & dual bounds
nodes.summary: Cyclic symmetrization T_{a,b,c}⊗T_{b,c,a}⊗T_{c,a,b} ≃ T_{abc} forces rank ≥ max{ab, bc, ca, (abc)^(3/4)}, giving 1/2 ≤ α_F ≤ 2/3 in the paper.
nodes.tex:
For all positive integers \(a,b,c\), the geometric border rank of
\(T_{a,b,c}\) and its asymptotic rank over \(F\) are at least
\[
              \max\{ab,bc,ca,(abc)^{3/4}\}.
\]
Over every field, \(1/2\le\alpha_F\le2/3\).

nodes.title: Lean 4 · Exact rectangular & α = 1/2
nodes.summary: OAI.LinearAlgebra.SpectralBooks.ExactExponent proves square_exponent = 9/4, tightens dual_exponent to exact α = 1/2, and pins rectangular_exponent for all weights (a, b, c) for division-free formal circuits.

nodes.title: Corollary · Extremal wire lengths = 3/4
nodes.summary: At every scale-one spectral point maximizing T_n, all three wire lengths equal 3/4 (tripod arms 3/8, 3/8, 3/8), giving T_{a,b,c} value (abc)^(3/4).
nodes.tex:
Fix \(n\ge2\) and a field \(F\). At every scale-one spectral point
maximizing the value of \(T_n\), all three wire lengths are \(3/4\).
There exists such a point, and it assigns \(T_{a,b,c}\) the value
\((abc)^{3/4}\) for every choice of positive integers \(a,b,c\).

nodes.title: Lemmas 2.4–2.5 · Bilinearize & specialize
nodes.summary: Evaluate circuit on A+uX, B+vY (u²=v²=0) to extract rank ≤ 2q even with divisions, then reduce the finitely generated coefficient ring modulo a maximal ideal via Zariski's lemma to a finite field k with ω_k < 9/4.
nodes.tex:
If \(\omega_F<9/4\) over a field \(F\), then \(\omega_k<9/4\)
over some finite field \(k\).

nodes.summary: Assisted cost β_p(T) equals the minimum price over all extensions p̂. The Gauss lift extends prices to valued fields K = Frac(E[t^ℚ]) with a nonarchimedean submean inequality on stars.

paper_decls.name: A decoder with short rows
paper_decls.tex:
For every \(\epsilon>0\) there is a \(\delta>0\) such that for
unbounded fourth powers \(N\) the \(N\) output bilinear forms \(B_e\)
of this product admit decompositions
\[
    B_e=S_e+R_e,\qquad
    \operatorname{rank}S_e\le N^\epsilon,\qquad
    \dim\langle R_e:1\le e\le N\rangle\le N^{1-\delta}.
\]

paper_decls.name: Lemma (lem:continuum-profile)
paper_decls.tex:
There is a continuous coordinatewise nondecreasing function $P$ on the positive
orthant such that, if $L_i/N\to t_i>0$, then
\[
 H(M(L))=D\log N+P(t)+o(1),\qquad P(ct)=P(t)+D\log c.
\]
For polynomials in $m$ variables with total input degrees at most
$\lfloor Nt_i\rfloor$, the corresponding price is
$mD\log N+mP(t)-D\log(m!)+o(1)$ for each fixed $m$.

paper_decls.name: Profile near contact
Adding an input
paper_decls.tex:
If $\varnothing\ne A'\subseteq A$ and $s>0$, then
\begin{equation}
 B_A(f)-B_A(f+s\mathbf1)\ge
 B_{A'}(f)-B_{A'}(f+s\mathbf1),
\end{equation}
with costs restricted to the indicated input set. If all sites in a
restricted placement coincide, its energy is zero.

paper_decls.name: Continuum limit of the degree energy
Radial contraction
paper_decls.tex:
Move each input $i$ towards the output along its geodesic, to a fraction
$0<\lambda_i\le1$ of its original distance. Write $A'$ for the resulting
placement and $\ell'_i=\lambda_i\ell_i$. For $s>0$ one has
\begin{equation}
 Q_A(\ell)-Q_A(\ell+s\mathbf1)\ge
 Q_{A'}(\ell')-Q_{A'}(\ell'+s\mathbf1)
\end{equation}
when both placements have positive common-label rate.

paper_decls.name: A fixed choice of widths
paper_decls.tex:
There are constants $b\in\mathbb N$ and $\lambda<2$ such that for
every $z\ge1$ the two width-$bz$ demands are the sum of a bounded
number of networks on the same six parties. Each uses at most
$2\lambda b$ bundles of $z$ bits on permitted edges. Its local
tensors are specified by $z$, the party and the index of the summand.
The index set and choices of widths (in units of $z$) can be fixed independently of $z$.

paper_decls.name: Dimension of a level
paper_decls.tex:
For every $h\in\frac12\mathbb Z_{\ge0}$ one has $d_h\le e^{c\sqrt h}$.
As $h\to\infty$ through all half-integral levels,
\[
   d_h\sim

\]

paper_decls.name: Fusion width
paper_decls.tex:
For $e,g\in\frac12\mathbb Z_{\ge0}$ put
\[
 H(e,g)=(\sqrt e+\sqrt g)^2+(\sqrt e+\sqrt g)/\sqrt2.
\]
The map
\[
 \bigoplus_{h\le H(e,g)} V_h \longrightarrow
       \operatorname{Hom}(V_g,V_e),\qquad
 (v_h)_h\longmapsto\sum_h I_e(v_h,-)
\]
is surjective. In the wedge bases, each matrix unit has an integral preimage.

paper_decls.name: Bilinearization of a formal circuit
paper_decls.tex:
If a formal circuit for multiplying two \(s\)-by-\(s\) matrices over
\(F\) uses \(q\) nonscalar multiplication or division gates, then
\begin{equation}
                     \operatorname{rank}_{\overline F}(T_s)\le 2q .
\end{equation}

import OAI.LinearAlgebra.MatrixExponent.Integral.RingFormula
import OAI.LinearAlgebra.SpectralBooks.DualExponent
import OAI.LinearAlgebra.SpectralBooks.RectangularCircuitModel
import OAI.LinearAlgebra.SpectralBooks.SquareRankModel

namespace OAI

/-- The square matrix multiplication exponent over every field. -/
theorem square_exponent (F : Type*) [Field F] : formalOmega F 1 1 1 = (9 : ℝ) / 4 :=
  (formalOmega_square_eq_omega F).trans (MatrixExponent.omega_eq F)

/-- The dual matrix multiplication exponent over every field. -/
theorem dual_exponent (F : Type*) [Field F] : formalAlpha F = (1 : ℝ) / 2 := by
  obtain ⟨hs, hr⟩ := MatrixExponent.omega_eq_and_rigidity F
  calc
    formalAlpha F = MatrixExponent.Rectangle.dual F 1 1 := by
      unfold formalAlpha dualExponent MatrixExponent.Rectangle.dual
      congr 1
      ext t
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, min_self, one_add_one_eq_two]
      apply and_congr_right
      intro ht
      rw [formalOmega_eq_integral, MatrixExponent.Integral.agreement F ht.1 zero_le_one zero_le_one,
        MatrixExponent.Rectangle.cycle F ht.1 zero_le_one zero_le_one]
    _ = (1 : ℝ) / 2 := MatrixExponent.Rectangle.dual_square hr hs

private theorem benchmark_sorted (a b c : ℝ) :
    MatrixExponent.Rectangle.U c b a =
      let x := max a (max b c)
      let z := min a (min b c)
      let y := a + b + c - x - z
      x + y + (max ((x + y) * z - x * y) 0) ^ 2 / (4 * x * y * z) := by
  let x := max a (max b c)
  let z := min a (min b c)
  let y := a + b + c - x - z
  change MatrixExponent.Rectangle.U c b a = MatrixExponent.Rectangle.benchmark x y z
  have sorted (u v w : ℝ) (hw : w = z)
      (huv : (u = x ∧ v = y) ∨ (u = y ∧ v = x)) :
      MatrixExponent.Rectangle.benchmark u v w = MatrixExponent.Rectangle.benchmark x y z := by
    rcases huv with ⟨hu, hv⟩ | ⟨hu, hv⟩ <;> rw [hu, hv, hw]
    simp only [MatrixExponent.Rectangle.benchmark, add_comm y x, mul_comm y x,
      show 4 * y * x = 4 * x * y by ring]
  unfold MatrixExponent.Rectangle.U
  split_ifs <;> apply sorted <;> dsimp only [x, y, z] <;> grind

/-- The exact rectangular exponent with the nonnegative parts of the weights sorted
in descending order. On coordinate planes the correction term is zero. -/
theorem rectangular_exponent (F : Type*) [Field F] (a b c : ℝ) :
    formalOmega F a b c =
      let A := max a 0
      let B := max b 0
      let C := max c 0
      let x := max A (max B C)
      let z := min A (min B C)
      let y := A + B + C - x - z
      x + y + (max ((x + y) * z - x * y) 0) ^ 2 / (4 * x * y * z) := by
  rw [formalOmega_max_zero F a b c, formalOmega_eq_integral,
    MatrixExponent.Integral.exponent_eq F (le_max_right ..) (le_max_right ..) (le_max_right ..)]
  exact benchmark_sorted _ _ _

end SpectralBooks
end LinearAlgebra
end OAI

/-- The polynomial produced at one gate from the polynomials in its registers. -/
def gatePolynomial (g : Gate F I R) (v : R → MvPolynomial I F) : MvPolynomial I F :=
  g.casesOn (fun c => C c) (fun i => X i)
    (fun i j => v i + v j) (fun i j => v i - v j) (fun i j => v i * v j)

/-- Formal polynomial in each register of a straight-line program. -/
def registerPolynomial : {r : ℕ} → Program F I r → Fin r → MvPolynomial I F
  | _, .nil => Fin.elim0
  | _, .step p g => Fin.cases (gatePolynomial g (registerPolynomial p)) (registerPolynomial p)

/-- Formal correctness in the paper, including over a finite ground field. -/
def FormalCorrect {a b c : ℕ} (P : MatrixAlgorithm F a b c) : Prop :=
  ∀ i k, registerPolynomial P.program (P.output i k) =
    ∑ j : Fin b, X (Sum.inl (i, j)) * X (Sum.inr (j, k))

end

/-- The integer wire dimension at scale `N` and weight `w`. -/
def wireDimension (N : ℕ) (w : ℝ) : ℕ := ⌈(N : ℝ) ^ w⌉₊

/-- Admissible exponents for the rounded rectangular formats, with positive slack. -/
def FormalAdmissibleExponent (F : Type*) [Field F] (w12 w23 w31 τ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N →
    ∃ P : MatrixAlgorithm F (wireDimension N w31) (wireDimension N w12) (wireDimension N w23),
      FormalCorrect P ∧ (P.cost : ℝ) ≤ C * (N : ℝ) ^ (τ + ε)

/-- The arithmetic exponent in base size `N` at three prescribed wire weights. -/
def formalOmega (F : Type*) [Field F] (w12 w23 w31 : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sInf {τ : ℝ | FormalAdmissibleExponent F w12 w23 w31 τ}

/-- The square matrix multiplication exponent over every field. -/
theorem square_exponent (F : Type*) [Field F] : formalOmega F 1 1 1 = (9 : ℝ) / 4 := by
  sorry

/-- The supremum of the weights in `[0, 1]` at which the cost exponent is two. -/
def dualExponent (ω : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup {t : ℝ | t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 ∧ ω t = 2}

/-- The dual exponent for formal arithmetic matrix multiplication at weights `(1,1,t)`. -/
def formalAlpha (F : Type*) [Field F] : ℝ := dualExponent (formalOmega F 1 1)

/-- The dual matrix multiplication exponent over every field. -/
theorem dual_exponent (F : Type*) [Field F] : formalAlpha F = (1 : ℝ) / 2 := by
  sorry

/-- The exact rectangular exponent with the nonnegative parts of the weights sorted
in descending order. On coordinate planes the correction term is zero. -/
theorem rectangular_exponent (F : Type*) [Field F] (a b c : ℝ) :
    formalOmega F a b c =
      let A := max a 0
      let B := max b 0
      let C := max c 0
      let x := max A (max B C)
      let z := min A (min B C)
      let y := A + B + C - x - z
      x + y + (max ((x + y) * z - x * y) 0) ^ 2 / (4 * x * y * z) := by
  sorry

end
